sloka: नेदुः बलस्य अभिमुखम् ज्वाल उद्गारिभिः आननैः ।कबन्धः परिघ आभासो दृश्यते भास्कर अंतिके ॥३-२३-११॥
transliteration: neduḥ balasya abhimukham jvāla udgāribhiḥ ānanaiḥ ।kabandhaḥ parigha ābhāso dṛśyate bhāskara aṁtike ॥3-23-11॥

translations.english: The planet Ketu appeared like an iron beam near the Sun. Although it was not the fullmoon or newmoon day, Rahu eclipsed the Sun. Wind blew hard and the Sun was lustreless.
